market_name: Will 12 or more Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether 2y/10y Treasury yields are declining and fed funds futures (SOFR/ZQ) are repricing dovishly; confirm the prediction-market move is not a thin-liquidity blip.
time_plan.1h: Compare TLT move vs. rate-futures implied cuts; look for a coincident risk-off signal (VIX up, equities down) to validate the recession-tail read.
time_plan.2h: Reassess if any macro headline (jobs, CPI, Fed speak, financial-stability event) explains the move; if already public, downgrade signal.
time_plan.6h: Evaluate persistence of the yield decline and whether the prediction-market probability held or reverted.
time_plan.12h: Mark TLT return vs. entry; note whether the rate-cut narrative was corroborated by other rate assets or faded as noise.

predictions.reasoning: A market on 12+ Fed cuts in 2026 (=300bps of easing) is a deep-recession/crisis tail. A sharp rise in its implied probability would signal expectations of aggressive, possibly emergency, easing — which pushes front- and long-end yields down and bond prices up. TLT is the most liquid long-duration proxy for that rate-expectations shift. Magnitude is small over 12h because the market is a low-probability tail bet and any leak is noisy.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check VIX and equity futures for risk-off confirmation; verify the prediction-market shift is real, not thin.
time_plan.1h: Cross-check whether bonds are rallying alongside equity weakness (classic recession-tail combo) vs. easing-driven risk-on.
time_plan.2h: Scan for a triggering headline; if the move is purely 'good news easing', flip thesis toward equities up.
time_plan.6h: Assess persistence and whether credit spreads (HYG) are widening to support the distress read.
time_plan.12h: Record SPY return vs. entry and whether the recession-tail interpretation held.

predictions.reasoning: Twelve cuts imply a severe growth shock, so a rising probability here is a recession/crisis signal that typically pressures equities in the near term (before any 'Fed put' relief dominates). However the sign is ambiguous — aggressive easing can also be bid as a tailwind — so confidence is low and direction could invert.

evidence_used: Market question implies 300bps of cuts in 2026, an extreme dovish/recession tail
Rate-cut expectations map most directly to Treasury yields (TLT) and the dollar
Deep-easing scenarios historically coincide with risk-off in equities and credit
uncertainty_notes: The 700bps tradability threshold is implausible for these liquid ETFs over 12h; neither prediction qualifies as tradable
Sign of equity move is genuinely ambiguous (recession fear vs. Fed-put relief)
A 12+ cut market is a deep tail; small probability moves carry little information and are easily dominated by noise
Cannot verify current implied probability or whether any move is already public

llm_justification.summary: The market prices an extreme 300bps-of-easing (12+ cut) recession/crisis tail for 2026. If its implied probability jumped sharply, the cleanest read is aggressive dovish repricing: long Treasuries (TLT) up on falling yields, with equities (SPY) likely lower on the implied growth shock — though the equity sign is ambiguous because easing can also be risk-positive. Expected 12h magnitudes are small and below the tradable threshold; this is a weak, noisy mapping best treated as low-confidence research.
key_assumptions: A rise in this market's probability reflects genuine dovish/recession expectations, not thin liquidity
Rate-expectation shifts transmit to TLT and equities within the 12h window
No overriding contemporaneous catalyst reverses the signal
failure_modes: The prediction-market move is noise/illiquid and no asset moves
The information is already public (priced into rates before the market moved)
Equities rally on 'easing = good' rather than fall on 'recession fear', inverting the SPY call
TLT weakly tracks a tail bet on 2026 cuts if the move is concentrated in a specific meeting rather than the whole path
Move reverses as the extreme 12-cut scenario is deemed implausible
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
